item.title: What a staffing business taught me about software margins
item.description: Labor businesses teach you things software founders learn late and expensively. The most useful lesson is that gross margin is a habit, not a number.

item.title: Why we hold companies instead of flipping them
item.description: The exit is the default goal in almost every founder conversation. After twenty years of building, I think it's the wrong default for most businesses.
